notes.title: A new combat demo is OUT!
notes.content:
Good times to you!

After a long period of radio silence I guess it's time to say that this time was spent working on a new content for the game: to be blunt, in it's last iteration, the game looks very shallow and boring: the locations are very empty and short, the quests are very straight-forward, and the combat system lacks overall depth. That's why it was decided to spent time overhauling those things. Today's highlight is...

[h1]COMBAT SYSTEM OVERHAUL[/h1]

[h2]UNIT STATS AND DICE ROLLS[/h2]

Before, one of the combat aspects was randomness. It wasn't particularly fair that the player's impact on the combat outcome was dependent on such thing, so it was decided to remove it completely. Well, almost completely, as the skills that gets shuffled into your hand and enemy behavior (this one actually can change depending on the environment) still depend on chances, but hey, at least it's better than losing due to having 95% accuracy and still missing, right?

As such, the following stats were removed:
- Accuracy
- Evasion
- Critical Chance

Take a note that the critical damage stat is still present and is used to buff some special empowered attacks.

Along with this, there are a few stats that were added:

- Walk - determines the maximum radius a unit can move per turn. This stat was present before, but now it is officially implemented
- Readiness - determines the intervals between units' actions (we will talk about it further below)
- Fortitude - a value that affects the duration of negative effects applied on a unit
- Incoming healing - a multiplier of a unit's incoming healing
- Incoming healing - a multiplier of a unit's incoming healing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/7a55b42780144fef9eb2caa41b3ec985b0ea225a.png[/img]

[h2]SPECIAL SKILLS[/h2]

Hyper abilities were removed. Yep. The idea of having a skill that grants a unit a power spike at the cost of charging it for several turns, so, to smooth the difficulty curve a bit, they were replaced with a special skills tab: those skills are either innate to the owner, or can be obtained via various combat interactions. Try experimenting a bit! Who knows what you can find?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/0d179bd31bf2e359e46d6297d16cb3b8392305e3.png[/img]

[h2]TURNS[/h2]

The old combat turn system worked this way: you wait until you fill you Time Points gauge, then spend some of that TP to use skills or walk... which wasn't particularly balanced! I mean, there were no skills that required all of you TP, right? That is why is was decided to change it for the better: the new combat system uses act timers: act timers are activated after you use skills or move. The values of the timer, as mentioned above, are determined by the Readiness stat. Moving sets timers to only half of its duration. Using items does not activate timers at all! Once the timer is off, units can act.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/076623dae513b1a801fa867c3ce9ada67780eff1.png[/img]

[h2]BLOOD[/h2]

One of the last but not the least changes: units now shed some blood depending on the circumstances (taking damage, using specific skills etc). Asides from being a cool visual addition, it actually has an impact on the gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/56bce66bf487ec99283be311898c1226b5095f59.png[/img]

[h2]AND ALSO...[/h2]
- New skills
- New status effects
- A lot of bugfixes
- General polishing and QoL additions

[h2]SO, THE DEMO?[/h2]

The demo features a revamped combat encounter from the main game. To play it, you must select it in the beta branches of the game in your Steam library by going to the game's properties. Unfortunately, this will replace your base game with a demo, but you can switch back to it whenever you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/7bd240865613c125d07ad6ed3128b6706cc3c0b2.png[/img]

Alternatively, if you don't own the base game (hold on, is this even possible?!), you can download it directly from the store page. Otherwise, it will be overwritten by the base game. Unfortunately, Steam does not handle separate demo build, so these are the only solutions.

To sum this up, I have to say: the last year was really hard on me and my siblings, but I still tried to work hard and finish this demo before its 2nd anniversary. Unfortunately, I did not manage to finish working on the first chapter, mainly because of my real life issues and the low income from the game sales. So I'd be really grateful if you spread the word about it in any way. The future of the game lies in your hands.

That's all for now. See you soon, Seeker...

notes.title: Devlog: Overworld movement
notes.content:
Good times to you! It's been a while since I've made a somewhat consistent post regarding what exactly is in development, or what kind of features are to be included to the game, so here's a sneak peek at the new movement mechanics I'm currently implementing (note that changes are to be expected later on)!

[h1]Sprint Overhaul[/h1]
Unlike in the previous versions, the character now has to accumulate energy before sprinting at full speed. It is done by holding the sprint key (which is RMB now instead of L. Shift by default), all until you see a visual indication showing that you can run at maximum speed. Note that you can accumulate energy even while standing still.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/b5f2dfb833acaf3ecd89e999a25348244ac1e293.gif[/img]

[h1]Jumping[/h1]
Yes, Seeker can now jump! This is not a cosmetic feature as you can see. Not much to say about it, other than it opens vast opportunities for creating many parkour puzzles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/53f33b0100c2a40065390a8d6f21037ff2495ae1.gif[/img]

[h1]Coiling[/h1]
And one more thing: Seeker can now coil while mid-air (L. Shift by default) to compress himself during the flight. This is useful while jumping over big gaps or obstacles without breaking the flow of the run.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/329d7122ec2a32f8049e880b1b40ea91cdd77c03.gif[/img]

As it was said in the beginning, those features are partially experimental, they may be expanded/reworked in the future.

notes.title: Plans regarding the game | Roadmap
notes.content:
Good times to you!

It's been a while since I've posted something newsworthy, and it's also been more than a year since the first build of the game has been uploaded to Steam, so I think it's time to share some thoughts with you.

[h1]So what happened?[/h1]

As mentioned earlier, the game has been in the early access state for a year already, and, frankly, it hasn't made much progress since then. The only reasonable explanations I can give are fruitless sales of the game (thus the lack of funding), real life problems, the fact that it's only one person that actively works on the game, and my own lack of motivation, since the game has been almost under the radars. That being said, I'm not proud of any of these, so I'm planning to take some actions towards stabilizing this situation.

[h1]My plans[/h1]

Firstly, the game's prologue is almost concluded, only missing some small parts which will be added in the upcoming update that will be released before the end of the year. And, secondly, right after it, I'll start actively working on the next chapter of the game. I can't tell much about it at the moment, other than that the full prologue is only about 10-15% of the next chapter, and that it will feature a lot of new mechanics and content. [b]The next chapter's release date is somewhen at Q3 of 2022[/b]. Again, I can't promise anything, especially knowing that it's a titanic amount of work to tackle by a person like me, but I've got no other choice but to try.

That being said, I will try my best. Thanks for playing the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/d15b5f2ee5a4d64d947768f188b3238063cf3091.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog: Plans
notes.content:
[b]Good times to you![/b]

With this post, I'm starting a series of blog posts which will contain bits of information regarding the development behind OverTime!

The question the might bother some of the players is "where's the update?", and to answer this, I should explain the current state of the game more detailed. The current version of the game is 0.005a, and the "a" stands for "alpha". In other words the current version of the game contains a good part of additions from the previous version, but it's still missing some content and, on top of that, doesn't offer a logical ending to the current plotline. With this being said, I'd like to let you know that the wait is almost over, and that the time spent was utilized to revamp some of the aspects of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/42bb6bc75b09dd3e0e3562e3f52dd63cd9b54416.png[/img]

Please stay tuned and wait for more info!

notes.title: Jet-coloured Blood Update is in alpha state!
notes.content:
[b]Good times to you![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/753b3128562a800188b007fffccd6704051c0f9d.png[/img]

I'm happy to announce that the [b]Jet-coloured Blood[/b] update is now live in alpha!

The detailed patch notes with the changes will be posted later, when the update is moved out of alpha branch in which it is now.

As of now, there are certain things to highlight:

- A direct expansion of the story is available!
- A complete rebalance of the combat system, including things like character cards and status effects!
- A lot of fixes and other quality-of-life improvements to the game!

Unfortunately, it was not possible to implement all the planned content so fast due to the limited development resources (as such, Russian and Spanish translations are not yet ready), but this will be fixed later.

As mentioned earlier, I'll address all the changes when the time will come, but for now, happy playtime, and happy holidays! Tell your friends about OverTime!

notes.title: A Notice Regarding the Upcoming Update
notes.content:
[b]Good times to you![/b]

In this announcement, I'd like to let you know that the [b]Jet-coloured Blood[/b] update is almost ready. If no complications arrive, the update should be out by [b]the 31st of December[/b]. Along with that, I'd like to inform you that the update will expand the game towards the full prologue, but not completely, as there are a couple of other content updates planned for the game before moving towards developing another large expansion.

I'd also like to remind you that it's best to remove your old save files and start a new game, as loading older save files may (and most likely will) cause some serious glitches during gameplay, which is related to systemizing the base of the game's code. A respective function will be available in the game's settings. Again, sorry for the inconvenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/caa8c4e91767dc99fddcf4a031b11ab23e31edd8.png[/img]

I hope that you will enjoy the update, and I also hope that you will let your friends know about OverTime!

notes.title: Jet-coloured Blood Update Preview
notes.content:
[b]Good times to you![/b]

I'd like to thank the players who have already played OverTime and are still here to continue the journey. And so, to make your wait less boring, it was decided to share the details regarding the biggest game update yet called [b]Jet-coloured Blood[/b].

The new update will add a direct continuation of the story. Be ready to travel further on and traverse various locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/9466df540540c424dce1971ca2177eb9548b083b.png[/img]

The new locations will contain a variety of new points of exploration, as well as new characters: friendly, hostile or... something that you will decide by yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/13ed9a253781f06a01ac7d14889e00d64b5c73dc.png[/img]

Additionally, I'd like to let you know that the game will receive a lot of rebalancing and adjustments to a number of gameplay aspects, such as overworld interactions and combat, all for the sake of making your game experience better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879915/d4f3fb43cef0bc013fa23a831dfccb7775c758c0.png[/img]

I hope that you will enjoy the update, and I also hope that you will let your friends know about OverTime!

[b]IMPORTANT NOTICE: the update will most likely require you to start a new game, as some of the save files may be corrupted due to the renovation of the game's code base. Sorry for the inconvenience.[/b]

- added the ability to reveal combat bars' details by holding Alt.
- Minor UI adjustments.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed some text typos.

- A lot of bug fixes of all sizes, making you playtime safer.

That's it for the update time. Stay tuned and wait until the next one!
